entries.title: Pull request numbers on Firstmate's and the crew's cards open the pull request
entries.body: When Firstmate or a crewmate knows a pull request's address, it now writes the pull request number on its card as a link. Click it to open that pull request. It looks like the pull request link on a task's card and on a card that merges: in the accent color, underlined while the pointer rests on it.

picture.alt: A note from Firstmate saying two pull requests merged, with PR #58 and PR #61 drawn as links in the accent color
